abstract: Dermoids are mature teratomas lined with a stratified squamous epithelium. They are known to present anywhere in the body, mostly with minimal or no associated symptoms. The authors present the case of a 44-year-old man who presented with an acute abdomen suggestive of appendiceal disease. On surgical exploration, the patient was found to have an inflamed cystic lesion in the mesoappendix that was resected and diagnosed as a dermoid cyst on pathological examination. This is the seventh case in the literature of a periappendiceal dermoid, but the first that presents in such a manner. This report is presented because of its important clinical applications for the general surgeon.
abstract_ja: 類皮嚢腫は重層扁平上皮に覆われた成熟奇形腫である。多くは症状がほとんどないか全くなく、体のどこにでも生じうる。44歳男性が、虫垂疾患を示唆する急性腹症で来院した。外科的探索で、虫垂間膜に炎症を伴う嚢胞性病変を認めた。これを切除し、病理学的検査で類皮嚢腫と診断された。虫垂周囲類皮嚢腫は文献上7例目であるが、このような提示様式は初めてである。一般外科医にとって臨床的に重要な知見であるため、本症例を報告する。
